title: Frontend Developer
tagline: Turn ideas into polished, interactive web experiences.
description: Learn how the web works, build responsive interfaces, and publish a portfolio that proves your skills.

lessons.title: HTML foundations
lessons.description: Understand semantic HTML, page structure, forms, links, and accessible markup.
lessons.practice: Build a personal profile page with headings, a contact form, and useful links.

lessons.title: CSS and layout
lessons.description: Style interfaces with selectors, the box model, Flexbox, Grid, and reusable design tokens.
lessons.videoTitle: CSS Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Recreate a clean pricing card and a responsive navigation bar.

lessons.title: JavaScript essentials
lessons.description: Write variables, functions, conditions, loops, arrays, objects, and DOM interactions.
lessons.practice: Create a task list that can add, complete, and delete tasks.

lessons.title: Git and GitHub workflow
lessons.description: Track changes, make commits, create branches, and publish work to GitHub.
lessons.practice: Push one mini-project to GitHub and write a useful README.

lessons.title: Responsive design
lessons.description: Design mobile-first layouts with flexible sizing, media queries, and accessible interactions.
lessons.practice: Make your profile page work well at 360px, 768px, and desktop widths.

lessons.title: React fundamentals
lessons.description: Build component-based interfaces with props, state, effects, and reusable composition.
lessons.videoTitle: React Course - Beginner's Tutorial for React JavaScript Library
lessons.practice: Build a searchable list or simple expense tracker using React.

lessons.title: Working with APIs
lessons.description: Fetch data, handle loading and error states, and connect a user interface to an API.
lessons.practice: Create a page that searches and displays data from a public API.

lessons.title: Portfolio and deployment
lessons.description: Polish two projects, write case-study notes, and deploy your portfolio publicly.
lessons.practice: Publish a portfolio with two projects, screenshots, and working links.

title: Full-Stack Developer
tagline: Build complete products from the interface to the database.
description: Move from browser fundamentals to APIs, authentication, data storage, and a deployable full-stack project.

lessons.title: How the web works
lessons.description: Learn browsers, HTTP, URLs, client-server requests, and how a web application is delivered.
lessons.practice: Inspect network requests on three websites and describe what happens after a click.

lessons.title: HTML and CSS
lessons.description: Create semantic pages and build responsive layouts with Flexbox, Grid, and media queries.
lessons.practice: Build a responsive landing page from a simple wireframe.

lessons.title: JavaScript core
lessons.description: Become comfortable with arrays, objects, functions, modules, promises, and async/await.
lessons.practice: Build a searchable, filterable catalogue using local JSON data.

lessons.title: React frontend
lessons.description: Structure a frontend with components, hooks, routing concepts, forms, and reusable UI.
lessons.practice: Build a multi-page dashboard with a filter and edit form.

lessons.title: Node.js fundamentals
lessons.description: Use JavaScript on the server, work with modules, environment variables, and asynchronous I/O.
lessons.practice: Create a small command-line app that reads and writes a JSON file.

lessons.title: REST APIs with Express
lessons.description: Design endpoints, validate inputs, use middleware, and return consistent API responses.
lessons.practice: Build CRUD endpoints for a study-task API and test them with an API client.

lessons.title: SQL and database design
lessons.description: Model relational data, write queries, join tables, and reason about keys and constraints.
lessons.practice: Design and query a simple users, courses, and progress database.

lessons.title: Authentication and deployment
lessons.description: Understand password hashing, sessions or tokens, secure configuration, and shipping an app.
lessons.videoTitle: Authentication and Web App Security Basics
lessons.practice: Deploy your app and document its setup, environment variables, and security limits.

title: Data Analyst
tagline: Turn messy data into decisions people can trust.
description: Build confidence in spreadsheets, SQL, Python, visualisation, and presenting business insights.

lessons.title: Excel for analysis
lessons.description: Clean tables, use formulas, create pivot tables, and summarise patterns in business data.
lessons.practice: Analyse a sample sales table and build a one-page KPI summary.

lessons.title: SQL fundamentals
lessons.description: Query structured data with SELECT, filters, grouping, joins, and subqueries.
lessons.videoTitle: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Answer ten business questions using SQL and save your queries.

lessons.title: Statistics for decision-making
lessons.description: Understand distributions, averages, variation, correlation, sampling, and uncertainty.
lessons.practice: Write five evidence-based observations and note what the data cannot prove.

lessons.title: Python foundations
lessons.description: Use variables, collections, loops, functions, files, and notebooks to automate analysis.
lessons.videoTitle: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Write a script that reads a CSV and reports row counts and missing values.

lessons.title: Pandas and data cleaning
lessons.description: Load datasets, inspect columns, handle missing values, transform types, and combine tables.
lessons.videoTitle: Data Analysis with Python and Pandas
lessons.practice: Clean a messy dataset and create a short before/after summary.

lessons.title: Data visualisation
lessons.description: Choose meaningful charts and communicate trends without misleading the audience.
lessons.practice: Create three charts answering one clearly stated business question.

lessons.title: BI dashboards
lessons.description: Design a dashboard with helpful KPIs, useful filters, and an obvious reading order.
lessons.videoTitle: Power BI Full Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Create a dashboard that answers who, what changed, and what to do next.

lessons.title: Portfolio project and storytelling
lessons.description: Use a real dataset to show the question, method, insight, limitation, and recommendation.
lessons.practice: Publish a notebook and a concise case study with three recommendations.

title: AI / ML Engineer
tagline: Build useful AI systems with strong foundations and real projects.
description: Start with Python and data, learn model building and evaluation, then ship an applied AI project.

lessons.title: Python programming
lessons.description: Learn the language fundamentals you need to manipulate data and build reliable programs.
lessons.practice: Build a command-line study tracker that saves progress to a file.

lessons.title: Math and statistics essentials
lessons.description: Build intuition for vectors, matrices, probability, distributions, and gradients.
lessons.practice: Explain a simple linear model with a small plotted dataset.

lessons.title: Data analysis with NumPy and Pandas
lessons.description: Load, inspect, clean, transform, and explore data before training any model.
lessons.practice: Create a reproducible notebook that cleans and explores a public dataset.

lessons.title: Machine learning fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand supervised learning, feature engineering, train/test splits, and baseline models.
lessons.practice: Train a baseline model and compare it with a simple improved model.

lessons.title: Model evaluation and improvement
lessons.description: Choose metrics that fit the task, use cross-validation, and inspect model errors honestly.
lessons.practice: Compare models with at least two metrics and explain the trade-offs.

lessons.title: Neural networks and deep learning
lessons.description: Learn layers, activations, loss functions, optimisation, and when deep learning is appropriate.
lessons.practice: Train a small classifier and record how performance changes with training.

lessons.title: LLMs, embeddings, and RAG
lessons.description: Explore language-model prompting, embeddings, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation of AI answers.
lessons.practice: Build a small document Q&A prototype and test it with questions the source can answer.

lessons.title: Ship an applied AI project
lessons.description: Turn a clear user problem into a documented prototype with evaluation and a usable interface.
lessons.practice: Publish a demo, README, evaluation notes, limitations, and a short walkthrough.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
tagline: Learn to identify risk, investigate signals, and defend systems responsibly.
description: Build networking and Linux foundations, practise defensive security, and document a safe home lab.

lessons.title: Networking fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand IP addressing, DNS, ports, TCP/UDP, routing, and how traffic moves.
lessons.practice: Draw the path of a browser request and explain key protocols.

lessons.title: Linux and the command line
lessons.description: Navigate files, permissions, processes, logs, and shell commands in a safe environment.
lessons.practice: Create a Linux lab checklist and practise inspecting system logs.

lessons.title: Python for security tasks
lessons.description: Automate safe repetitive tasks with scripts, text processing, files, and simple network data.
lessons.practice: Write a log parser that counts event types from a sample file.

lessons.title: Security principles and threat modelling
lessons.description: Learn confidentiality, integrity, availability, least privilege, and basic risk analysis.
lessons.videoTitle: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Threat-model a simple student portal and suggest reasonable safeguards.

lessons.title: Web security fundamentals
lessons.description: Recognise common web risks, input validation issues, access-control gaps, and secure design habits.
lessons.practice: Use a deliberately vulnerable training lab only; document each finding and fix.

lessons.title: Logs, alerts, and SIEM basics
lessons.description: Understand log sources, detection rules, event context, and how alert triage works.
lessons.practice: Review sample logs and write a short incident timeline from the evidence.

lessons.title: Incident response
lessons.description: Follow a repeatable process for preparation, identification, containment, recovery, and lessons learned.
lessons.practice: Write a tabletop response plan for a suspicious account login.

lessons.title: Build a defensive security lab
lessons.description: Create a safe, isolated lab and present findings, hardening steps, and ethical boundaries.
lessons.practice: Publish a lab report using only authorised training systems and sample data.

title: UI/UX Designer
tagline: Design digital products that feel clear, useful, and human.
description: Learn user-centred thinking, create prototypes in Figma, test usability, and present case studies.

lessons.title: Visual design principles
lessons.description: Use hierarchy, spacing, contrast, typography, and consistency to guide attention.
lessons.practice: Audit a screen and improve its hierarchy with five deliberate changes.

lessons.title: User research and empathy
lessons.description: Plan interviews, ask neutral questions, identify needs, and separate evidence from assumptions.
lessons.practice: Interview three people about a real task and summarise recurring pain points.

lessons.title: Information architecture
lessons.description: Organise content and flows so people can understand where they are and what to do next.
lessons.practice: Map the user flow for signing up and completing one meaningful task.

lessons.title: Wireframes and layout
lessons.description: Explore layouts quickly before investing time in high-fidelity visuals.
lessons.practice: Draw three alternative layouts for the same task and explain the trade-offs.

lessons.title: Figma and components
lessons.description: Work with frames, auto layout, components, variants, and a consistent design system.
lessons.videoTitle: 2024 UI/UX Design Crash Course in Figma
lessons.practice: Turn a wireframe into a polished, reusable two-screen Figma design.

lessons.title: Interactive prototyping
lessons.description: Connect screens and design realistic states, transitions, forms, and feedback.
lessons.practice: Build a clickable prototype for one end-to-end user journey.

lessons.title: Usability testing and iteration
lessons.description: Observe users completing tasks, capture friction, and prioritise changes from evidence.
lessons.practice: Run three usability sessions and revise the design based on the findings.

lessons.title: Portfolio case study
lessons.description: Tell a clear story about the problem, research, design choices, testing, and outcomes.
lessons.practice: Publish a case study that shows your process, not only polished screens.

title: Product Manager
tagline: Find the right problem, align a team, and measure what changes.
description: Practise discovery, prioritisation, product metrics, cross-functional collaboration, and product storytelling.

lessons.title: Product management fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand product outcomes, lifecycle, responsibilities, and how product differs from project delivery.
lessons.practice: Write a one-page product brief for a problem you personally understand.

lessons.title: Customer discovery
lessons.description: Find real user problems through interviews, observation, and careful evidence gathering.
lessons.practice: Interview three target users and identify one problem worth validating further.

lessons.title: Problem framing and value proposition
lessons.description: Define the user, context, problem, desired outcome, and why an approach could help.
lessons.practice: Compare three possible solutions against the same user problem.

lessons.title: Product metrics and analytics
lessons.description: Use activation, retention, engagement, and conversion metrics to check product health.
lessons.practice: Define one north-star metric and three supporting metrics for your product idea.

lessons.title: Prioritisation and roadmaps
lessons.description: Compare opportunities transparently and balance impact, confidence, effort, and risk.
lessons.practice: Prioritise ten feature ideas and explain what you deliberately postpone.

lessons.title: Work with design and engineering
lessons.description: Write clear requirements, map flows, and collaborate without dictating implementation details.
lessons.videoTitle: Product Manager Working with Designers and Engineers
lessons.practice: Write five user stories with acceptance criteria for one small feature.

lessons.title: Agile delivery and experiments
lessons.description: Plan small increments, communicate risks, and design experiments to reduce uncertainty.
lessons.practice: Design a low-cost experiment that tests your riskiest product assumption.

lessons.title: Product case study and interviews
lessons.description: Explain decisions, trade-offs, metrics, and learning in a structured case study.
lessons.practice: Present a product case study in five minutes and answer likely follow-up questions.

title: Digital Marketer
tagline: Reach the right people, tell a clear story, and measure growth.
description: Combine audience research, SEO, content, social, email, and analytics into measurable campaigns.

lessons.title: Marketing fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand audiences, positioning, customer journeys, offers, and how marketing supports a business.
lessons.videoTitle: Digital Marketing Full Course for Beginners
lessons.practice: Write an audience profile and message map for a simple product.

lessons.title: SEO fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand search intent, on-page optimisation, site structure, and useful content practices.
lessons.practice: Audit one page and suggest five improvements based on user intent.

lessons.title: Content strategy and copywriting
lessons.description: Plan content around audience questions, choose formats, and write clear calls to action.
lessons.practice: Create a one-week content calendar with one measurable objective.

lessons.title: Social media strategy
lessons.description: Choose platforms based on audience and design a sustainable publishing and engagement routine.
lessons.practice: Plan five posts that serve one audience goal rather than chasing vanity metrics.

lessons.title: Email marketing and lifecycle
lessons.description: Build permission-based lists, useful messages, simple segments, and a welcome sequence.
lessons.practice: Draft a three-email onboarding sequence with a clear purpose for each message.

lessons.title: Analytics and measurement
lessons.description: Define conversion events and use reliable measurements to connect campaigns to outcomes.
lessons.practice: Create a weekly campaign report with goal, result, and next action.

lessons.title: Paid ads and experiments
lessons.description: Understand campaign structure, landing-page fit, budgets, testing, and ethical ad practices.
lessons.practice: Draft a small campaign brief with audience, budget assumptions, and success metric.

lessons.title: Campaign portfolio
lessons.description: Present a campaign plan, assets, measurement design, and honest learning outcomes.
lessons.practice: Create a portfolio case study using a real or clearly labelled practice campaign.

title: Cloud Engineer
tagline: Understand cloud infrastructure and deploy reliable services.
description: Learn Linux, networking, cloud building blocks, automation, monitoring, and a practical deployment.

lessons.title: Cloud computing foundations
lessons.description: Learn IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, regions, availability zones, scaling, and shared responsibility.
lessons.practice: Map a simple web application to compute, storage, networking, and identity services.

lessons.title: Linux essentials
lessons.description: Operate on the command line, inspect logs, manage permissions, and understand processes.
lessons.practice: Create a Linux command cheat sheet and use it to inspect a test environment.

lessons.title: Networking for cloud
lessons.description: Understand subnets, DNS, routing, firewalls, ports, and how cloud networks are segmented.
lessons.practice: Draw a two-tier architecture and explain how traffic is allowed or blocked.

lessons.title: Core cloud services
lessons.description: Explore virtual compute, object storage, managed databases, identity, and basic cost controls.
lessons.practice: Deploy a static site in a free-tier-eligible lab and clean up unused resources.

lessons.title: Cloud identity and security
lessons.description: Apply least privilege, secrets handling, encryption concepts, and secure defaults.
lessons.practice: Review a mock cloud architecture and list the highest-priority security improvements.

lessons.title: Automation and scripting
lessons.description: Use scripts and repeatable configuration to reduce manual infrastructure work.
lessons.practice: Automate a small file or reporting task and document how to run it.

lessons.title: Containers and CI/CD
lessons.description: Understand images, containers, environment configuration, and a simple build-and-deploy pipeline.
lessons.practice: Containerise a small web app and document the steps to run it.

lessons.title: Cloud deployment capstone
lessons.description: Deploy a small service with sensible access controls, monitoring, cost awareness, and documentation.
lessons.videoTitle: Deploy a Full-Stack App to the Cloud
lessons.practice: Publish a working deployment with an architecture diagram and a teardown checklist.

title: Career Explorer
tagline: Turn an open-ended ambition into a clear, testable learning plan.
description: A flexible starter path for a custom goal: research the role, learn the essentials, practise, build proof, and prepare for opportunities.

lessons.title: Map your goal and the role
lessons.description: Break your goal into the real-world responsibilities, outcomes, and skills the role requires.
lessons.videoTitle: How to research a career path
lessons.practice: Write a one-page role brief and list five skills or outcomes you need to demonstrate.

lessons.title: Learn the foundations
lessons.description: Build the core concepts and vocabulary you need before choosing advanced tools or topics.
lessons.videoTitle: Learning how to learn - beginner guide
lessons.practice: Create a glossary of 15 key terms and explain five in your own words.

lessons.title: Practise the core tools
lessons.description: Identify the tools commonly used in your target field and practise the most important workflows.
lessons.videoTitle: How to learn professional tools effectively
lessons.practice: Complete three small exercises with one commonly used tool in your target field.

lessons.title: Complete guided exercises
lessons.description: Use short, focused exercises to turn passive knowledge into repeatable skills.
lessons.videoTitle: How to practise a new skill effectively
lessons.practice: Complete five targeted exercises and keep a note of what you had to look up.

lessons.title: Build a small practical project
lessons.description: Apply the foundational concepts to a small project that solves a clear problem.
lessons.videoTitle: How to build a beginner portfolio project
lessons.practice: Build one small, finished project with a clear goal and evidence of the result.

lessons.title: Get feedback and improve
lessons.description: Use feedback, a checklist, or a real user test to find the weakest part of your work.
lessons.videoTitle: How to get feedback and improve your work
lessons.practice: Ask one person to review your work and make three specific improvements.

lessons.title: Create proof of your skills
lessons.description: Package your project, notes, and decisions into evidence another person can understand quickly.
lessons.videoTitle: How to create a beginner portfolio
lessons.practice: Create a one-page case study that explains the problem, your approach, and what changed.

lessons.title: Prepare for your next opportunity
lessons.description: Identify realistic next opportunities and explain your learning with clarity and evidence.
lessons.videoTitle: How to prepare for entry-level opportunities
lessons.practice: Find five suitable opportunities and adapt your project summary to one of them.
